thread:
maya: kicked off Mango13b int4 canary this morning. seeing coldstart token latency ~2.2s/token and two OOMs on canary-2. not sure if it's quant frag or config defaults. anyone else?
aj: saw the same on canary-2 around 09:18. memory map shows a spike after the 3rd request, fragmentation-ish. OOM only when max_new_tokens >= 1024. smaller gens OK.
toni: paste of the OOM trace from canary-2: ```ERROR: OutOfMemoryError: allocation failed at 0x7ff... stack: runtime/kernel.c:457 allocate_kv_slot()\nkv_cache_size=1.9G free=120M slabs=38\npreferred_batch=8 actual_batch=1\n```
liam: fwiw we enabled prefetch=1 in the onboarding profile to speed coldstarts; that seems to grow the KV slab on int4 models. prefetch helps cpu-bound latency but is hurting memory density here.
maya: hypothesis: int4 kernels + prefetch = high transient allocations -> fragmentation, then large max_new_tokens triggers OOM. quick mitigation: reduce default max_new_tokens + disable prefetch for mango13b-int4 and force microbatch=1 on canary. also suggest enabling KV trimming at eviction thresholds.
aj: +1 to defaults change. propose defaults: `max_new_tokens: 512`, `prefetch: 0`, `microbatch_size: 1`, `kv_trim_on_eviction: true`. That should cut peak by ~30-40% based on earlier heuristics.
liam: also propose a tiny boot warmup sequence (2 short requests) after model load to stabilize KV allocation order. sample curl: ```bash
curl -s -XPOST https://api.redwood.test/v1/infer -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"mango13b-int4","prompt":"warmup\\n","max_new_tokens":8}'
```
aj: adding warmup to the canary lifecycle makes sense. would be a low-cost safeguard.
maya: I'll create an onboarding patch with those defaults + notes in model metadata about int4 frag. leaving a short regen eval to check quality impact after lowering max_new_tokens. so far QA diffs look negligible for our tests.
liam: I'll push the canary config and trigger canary-3. will monitor token latency, mem, and OOM counts for 2 hours. will also add a small eval job that runs 100 short+10 long prompts.
ops-bot: deploy: canary-3 for mango13b-int4 started by liam at 2026-03-21T15:24:10Z.
maya: thanks. follow-up: if we still see fragmentation after these changes, next step is to try a small kernel tweak (defer some allocations) and a targeted compaction on idle. for now lets collect metrics and reconvene in #eng-ml in 2h. :hourglass:
